verdict.rationale: Devin is a coding agent, so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the pack shows Devin connecting to or using external MCP servers. The MCP evidence (devin-docs-6/23, devin-probe-4) describes Devin's own MCP server, which exposes Devin to other agents, so it cannot be credited to this client-side story.
